verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a SaaS research product like Marlin, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only a UI-driven, credit-based workflow (set a topic, a brief exchange with the user, then autonomous report generation) and never mentions a public API. Probes for llms.txt and OpenAPI/Swagger specs all returned 404, so nothing shows API access, let alone parity with the UI.
